lines.en: I drag my body, shifting slowly.
Something rolls beneath my belly.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方都在冒泡。
lines.en: Bubbles rise where I pass.
Eight limbs pull together.
Where I press, the grass lies flat.
Each step feels like walking in water.
I follow the low ground.
A dull thud follows my movement.
The little things inside me stir.
My steps are heavy and sink where they land.

lines.zh: 我趴着，让肚里的东西安静。
lines.en: I rest and let the things inside settle.
My belly swells in waves.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里有多少活物。
lines.en: Listening to how much lives in this grove.
Standing still is its own preparation.
Fine cracks spread across the ground.
Something clicks inside my mouth.
This body is charging up.

lines.zh: 我等着它们从里面出来。
lines.en: Waiting for them to come out of me.
My shell is slowly hardening.
The smells on the wind are jumbled.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸让泥面一起一伏。
lines.en: My breathing makes the mud rise and fall.
What's beneath my belly pushes up.
I don't want to move for now.
The water here seeps downward.
Waiting for a small tide.
Quiet, but growing.
You stand beside my clutch.
The ground under you is moving.
There are many in my belly.
Coming alone. Brave.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢有人靠近它们。
lines.en: I don't like anyone near them.
Your scent clings to the wet clay.

lines.zh: 我记住了你走路的重量。
lines.en: I've remembered the weight of your walk.
Here to look, or to take?
One step more and you'll tread on them.
Your boots would crack the shells.

lines.zh: 我看着你，你看着我的肚。
lines.en: I watch you; you watch my belly.
You'll regret this walk.

lines.zh: 腹侧的壳被砸得凹进去。
lines.en: The shell along my flank is caved in.
I cover the wound and pull back.
The things in my belly are thrashing.
That struck something soft.
Fluid runs down my body.
Pain makes me draw my front half in.
I won't go down that easily.
I want to retreat into the mud.
I can last a while longer.

lines.zh: 伤口渗出腥液，滴进泥里。
lines.en: Stinking fluid seeps from the wound into the mud.
Food? I prefer living things.

lines.zh: 搁在泥上，人退到三步外。
lines.en: Put it on the mud and back off three paces.
Not enough to share with the little ones.
I can swallow much more.
Rotting is fine. I'm not picky.

lines.zh: 你的手里有温热的东西。
lines.en: Your hands hold something warm.
Hear my belly growling?
I don't need feeding. I take.

lines.zh: 放低些，我的头弯不下来。
lines.en: Set it lower; my head won't bend that far.

lines.zh: 你后退时最好把它丢下。
lines.en: Best drop it as you back away.
You touched my belly.
Back off — the little ones get frightened.
I'm heavier than I look.
Don't crowd me. I need room to turn.
You've stepped into a mud pit.
One bump from you and the ground cracks.
Soft body, but it holds.
You've stepped on my clutch.
This close, you'll get the fluid on you.
This much weight doesn't yield quickly.
I already have something to guard.
They matter more than a partner.
This body is only for brooding.
That's a strange thing to ask.
I don't need another.
Not before the tide goes out.
My bloodline is in my belly.
Don't interrupt my brooding.
I don't understand such things.
I have my own way of living.

lines.zh: 我用腹底把它碾进泥里。
lines.en: I grind it into the mud beneath my belly.
It'll be perfect for lining the nest.
I roll it up and take it.
Too heavy. I'll drag it.
Tuck it away for later.
This serves my clutch.
Hands off. That's mine.
I picked it up to fill a hollow.
Too wet to hold well.
I swallowed the whole thing.
You've come far too close.
Marked. Stay where you are.
The things inside me are restless.
All this ground is mine.
You've trampled my clutch.

lines.zh: 我认准了你的位置，不动了。
lines.en: I've fixed your position and gone still.
I can hear your every step.

lines.zh: 腹里的这些，个个都是帮手。
lines.en: The things in my belly are all the help I need.
There's no direction out.

lines.zh: 我肚子里有东西会出来。
lines.en: Something will come out of my belly.
You've caught their attention.
The wet clay will catch your feet.
I'm sealing off this whole patch.
Standing right there suits me.
My front half rises.
I've waited a while for this.
I don't shout. I come.
Your scent is trembling.
You've backed to the tree.
No hurry. I have numbers.
My clutch is calling you.
Everywhere you stepped is wet.
I shifted half a step left.

lines.zh: 你砍我一下，会有更多出来。
lines.en: Cut me once and more will come out.
Rain's coming — bad for the ground.
I saw you switch hands.
Your breaths have gone short.
All of this is soft muck.
I hold still and wait for you.

lines.zh: 你往后退，就是往水里退。
lines.en: Retreating means backing into water.
I smell your blood.
There are gaps under your armor.
Tightening this circle, slowly.
They're already out.
No need to look down.
I've waited long enough for this.

lines.zh: 你抬脚的时候会慢半拍。
lines.en: You're half a beat slow lifting your foot.
I'm here. I'm not leaving.
My front half comes down!
Hitting you with my whole bulk.
This one carries acid.

lines.zh: 你踩到的那块地已经裂了。
lines.en: The ground you stepped on has split.

lines.zh: 我把你整条腿卷进腹下。
lines.en: I roll your whole leg under my belly.
They're crawling out from below.
A limb slaps your knee.

lines.zh: 你每退，我的腹就压近一尺。
lines.en: Each step back, my belly presses a foot closer.
This one strikes your waist.
My shell stops your blade.
Strike me and your hands will numb.
I push you down into the mud.

lines.zh: 这一下只是试你的甲有多硬。
lines.en: That was only to test how hard your armor is.
Your armor plate is creaking.
I'm dragged up out of the muck.
Everything beneath my belly wakes too.
This damp ground should be mine.
I raise my front half.
My shell is still soft. It needs time.
There's the smell of living things around.
I hold still, waiting for the tide.
The ground sinks beneath me.
My clutch is still buried in the mud.
I hear breathing.
I've left marks on every side.

lines.zh: 一点一点，我把肚子抬起来。
lines.en: Little by little, I lift my belly.
Someone lit a fire nearby.
I open my mouth, then close it.
Too dry here. I need water.
Waiting for this body to be ready.
There are many sounds under the mud.
I return faster than you'd think.
First I need a hollow to settle in.

lines.zh: 潮气把我的身体填满了。
lines.en: The damp has filled my body up.

lines.zh: 火烤干了壳，裂纹在扩大。
lines.en: Fire dried my shell and the cracks widened.

lines.zh: 从高处落下，腹部先着地。
lines.en: Fell from height, landing on my belly.

lines.zh: 水灌进腹腔，里面的东西慌了。
lines.en: Water flooded my belly — the brood panicked.

lines.zh: 爆炸把泥和壳一起掀开。
lines.en: The blast tore up mud and shell together.
An arrow sank into my soft belly.

lines.zh: 咒力在卵之间钻来钻去。
lines.en: Spellcraft worms between the eggs.

lines.zh: 我把肚子里的养分耗尽了。
lines.en: I've used up the nourishment in my belly.

lines.zh: 雷顺着一身湿壳流遍我。
lines.en: Lightning ran across my wet shell.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我的卵也是。
lines.en: Nothing below, and nothing for my clutch.
